meta.title: Pricing | Free for Founding Members, Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro
meta.description: Puntr is free for the first 100 Founding Members. Puntr Pro adds deeper sports analysis, advanced Tipster tools and planned PuntPoints Tipster Support from 1 December 2026.
meta.ogTitle: Puntr pricing: free for Founding Members
meta.ogDescription: Claim one of 100 Founding spots. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.

title: Pricing
subtitle: Start free as a Founding Member. Optional Pay-As-You-Go credits and Puntr Pro are planned for the official launch on 1 December 2026.

founding.title: Your place in the founding community
founding.f1: A permanent Founding badge, numbered #1 to #100
founding.f2: Full access to posting, your record and the weekly leaderboard
founding.f3: 30 free Pay-As-You-Go credits a month for 3 months once they launch

never: Paying never buys points, a higher ranking or prize eligibility. Eligible Tipsters may receive voluntary PuntPoints tips through the separate Tipster Support programme.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.a1: Yes. Founding Members use Puntr free. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.
